rulings.operator_words: The matcher left them open partly because the payments post to the gas lane and the invoices sit on the cylinder lane. That mismatch itself says someone should check. Cylinder Rentals should be handled in tbe gas lane not cylinder lane
rulings.ruling: Cylinder rental charges (stock 3112, SURE-MIX / SM CYL RENTAL) belong in the GAS lane (Part 1A), not the cylinder deposit lane (Part 1B). COF001 documents: 41576, 41577, 41578, 41579 (R250.00 each, 2025-03-18) and 49204 (R6,960.00, 2026-02-11), R7,960.00 in total. A lane mismatch between a payment and an invoice is itself a signal to check, not only a reason for the matcher to leave them open.
